message: View is actionable but has no accessible name.
Target is 34x52dp; below 44dp it is hard to hit for people with tremors or limited dexterity (Android guidance is 48dp).
Text contrast is about 3.6:1 (#CEE6CB on #108500); this passes only if the text is large-scale (WCAG's 18pt, or 14pt bold).
